headline: Kenya Airways Issues Profit Warning for 2026 Amid Rising Fuel and Parts Costs
summary: Kenya Airways issued a profit warning for 2026, citing surging fuel costs and aircraft parts shortages as it finalizes a state-backed recapitalization.
why: Kenya Airways is the flag carrier of Kenya, operating regional and international passenger and cargo flights across Africa and Europe.

impacts.name: Kenya Airways PLC
impacts.why: Kenya Airways issued a 2026 profit warning driven by increasing fuel costs and parts shortages.
